# MathJax boldsymbol extension

- Version: MathJax 3.2.2, matching the bundled `tex-mml-chtml.js`.
- Upstream: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mathjax/MathJax/3.2.2/es5/input/tex/extensions/boldsymbol.js
- License: Apache-2.0, as distributed by MathJax.
- SHA-256: `d6771fee0772db2657796c8d0e20e1878bb3237f6d3ed1e828e1834a4ff743ca`
- The 4,056-byte upstream file and the company Artifactory copy were compared byte for byte on 2026-10-08.

This extension is loaded on demand by `\boldsymbol` / `\bm`. Keeping it local
prevents otherwise self-contained reports from requesting a missing file.
